user.title: Connect to LedFx
user.description: Enter the address of your LedFx server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to LedFx. Check host and port.

abort.already_configured: This LedFx server is already configured.

init.title: LedFx Plus options
init.description: Choose which LedFx virtuals appear in Home Assistant. Deselected virtuals are removed together with their entities. Virtuals you create later in LedFx are added automatically.

set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Set a LedFx effect and/or change its settings (colours, gradient, speed, ...).

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: LedFx effect ID, e.g. energy, scroll, wavelength. Leave empty to only change the settings of the running effect.

config.name: Config
config.description: Effect settings to merge, e.g. gradient, color, speed, brightness.
